title: Connect a platform
description: Run your agents in your own Modal, Daytona or E2B account instead of the shared worker. Your token is tested before it is kept, stored encrypted, and never shown again.
sharedHint: Runs on the Heimdall shared worker.
confirmDisconnect: Disconnect {{platform}}? Its token is deleted; if it is the default, runs go back to the shared worker.
defaultNote: New evaluations run on {{worker}}. Tasks with services, teams, sessions or non-gateway faults stay on the shared worker's Docker and are refused on a platform, with the reason.
off: Worker platforms need the hosted server with a keystore master key.
